visualizations.title: 发布会会场 · 4 座看台 × 8 排共 1,108 席、18 块花篮垫位与零撞座选座锁
visualizations.title_en: Launch Arena · 1,108 seats in 4 stands × 8 rows, 18 basket mats and a zero-collision seat lock
visualizations.summary: 街角前厅的平面舞台：四座悬浮玻璃看台围住前厅，北 248 + 南 248 + 东 306 + 西 306 = 1,108 席，每座 8 排阶梯，逐排合计 144、144、144、140、136、136、132、132，席位编号沿用 chronoai-lobby v40 座位目录的写法（N1-17、E1-20、W8-01）；前厅里是主屏、Donna 的接待前台、小花看守的花店，以及世界地图墙前 2 排 × 9 块花篮垫位（basket-01 … basket-18）。拖动到场人数（1–1,250）与时间轴（T−75 到 T+25），看原子选座锁逐排逐个落座、重座恒为 0，第 1,109 位起转入 YouTube 与 LinkedIn 直播；小图把原子锁与无锁竞态（反事实）的重座数并排画出。五张实验卡：街角全貌、原子选座、满座溢流、花篮贺礼、T−0 开场。到场、选座与花篮时间表是示意模型，不是线上实测；2026-11-27 全流程彩排的实测（Donna 13 次预约与签到、0 掉单、中位 29 秒）另记在依据栏。
visualizations.summary_en: A floor plan of the Street Corner lobby: four floating glass stands enclose the lobby, North 248 + South 248 + East 306 + West 306 = 1,108 seats, eight tiered rows each with row totals 144, 144, 144, 140, 136, 136, 132, 132, and seat codes written the way the chronoai-lobby v40 seat catalog writes them (N1-17, E1-20, W8-01); inside sit the keynote screen, Donna's reception desk, Blossom's Flower Town and 2 rows × 9 basket mats along the world-map wall (basket-01 … basket-18). Drag the arrival load (1–1,250) and the rail (T−75 to T+25) to watch an atomic seat lock fill the rows one guest at a time with zero duplicate seats, routing guest 1,109 onward to the YouTube and LinkedIn live stream; a small plot sets the lock beside a naive race (a counterfactual). Five cards: the overview, the atomic seat lock, the full-house overflow, the flower baskets and T−0. The arrival, seating and basket schedules are an illustrative model, not measurements of the live system; the 2026-11-27 full-flow rehearsal measurements (Donna: 13 bookings and check-ins, 0 dropped, median 29 s) are noted separately in the evidence panel.

visualizations.title: 从发动机到整车 · 换引擎不停车，明文密钥不进上下文
visualizations.title_en: Engine-to-Vehicle Stack · swap the engine without stopping the car, no plaintext key in context
visualizations.summary: 整车的五层剖面：可替换的机舱（Engine Alpha、Engine Beta、Local Core）装在 NyxID、Ornn、CMA / heca、chrono-harness 与上线表面之上。沿时间轴追踪一次读调用与一次写调用穿过各层：机舱只拿到不透明的能力句柄，明文密钥只在 NyxID 边界之下出现，上下文中的明文密钥恒为 0；写操作在琥珀色人工闸门前等人批准；在 NyxID 吊销授权后，调用当场收到 403 REVOKED，沙箱在约 2.1 秒的热重载窗口内换上新绑定、无需重启。四张实验卡：热换发动机、凭证不进上下文、写操作人工闸门、一键吊销。时序是示意模型。
visualizations.summary_en: A five-layer cutaway of the vehicle: a swappable engine bay (Engine Alpha, Engine Beta, Local Core) mounted on NyxID, Ornn, CMA / heca, chrono-harness and the live surfaces. Trace one read call and one write call through the layers along the rail: the engine only ever holds an opaque capability handle, the plaintext key appears only below the NyxID boundary, and plaintext keys in context stay at 0; a write waits at the amber human gate until someone approves it; after the grant is revoked at NyxID the call is refused at once with 403 REVOKED, and sandboxes pick up the new binding within the ~2.1 s hot-reload window without a restart. Four cards: hot engine swap, zero-secret vault, write approval gate, instant revocation. The timing is an illustrative model.
